raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary
Fixes multi-turn Mean TPOT inflation under EAGLE/NEXTN on Ascend NPU by:
1. Preferring running decode over starting new waiting prefills (including chunked continuations) when speculative decoding is active and mixed-chunk is off
2. Resetting a disabled \chunked_prefill_size\ (\<= 0\) to **1024** for the EAGLE family

## Ascend issue
- https://github.com/Ascend/sglang/issues/1093
- Claimed by: **BaiBaiUu**

## NPU retest (Atlas 800T A2)
Bench: \sglang.benchmark.serving\ · generated-shared-prefix · turns=3 · C=2 · A=p=2\ · B=p=8\ · Qwen3-Next-80B + NEXTN

S4 (decode-prefer V2 + chunked 1024): **10/10 PASS** (\|Δ Mean TPOT| ≤ 1 ms\)

## Test plan
- [x] NPU A/B retest matrix (see Ascend issue comments / local RETEST)
- [ ] Upstream CI / maintainer un-ci
## Note
Replaces LongCatchen PR #40518 (wrong account for this claim). Closing that PR in favor of this one.
